description: AI-friendly semantic code search engine for large codebases. Combines ripgrep speed with tree-sitter AST parsing. Powers AI coding assistants with precise, context-aware code understanding.

summary.one_liner: Probe is a local, AST-aware code search and context engine (Rust, with an npm CLI and Node.js SDK) that pairs ripgrep-style speed with tree-sitter parsing and includes a built-in code-reasoning agent.
summary.what_it_does: Probe searches codebases using Elasticsearch-style boolean queries (AND, OR, NOT, phrases, ext:/lang:/file:/dir: filters) and returns complete functions, classes, or structs rather than line fragments. It supports AST pattern matching via a query command with metavariables like $NAME, symbol listing per file, and extraction of code blocks by line number or symbol name. Results can be ranked with BM25, TF-IDF, or hybrid rerankers and trimmed with a token budget and session dedup. It runs without indexing or embedding models, and the README says search is fully local. It can be used as an MCP server (agent mode or raw search/query/extract/symbols tools), as a direct CLI, or from Node.js via an agent class and functions, with a Vercel AI SDK tool wrapper. A built-in agent supports multiple LLM providers and an optional LLM Script DSL for multi-step plans.
use_cases: give an AI coding assistant precise context from a large codebase
find all implementations of a function or pattern by AST structure
answer questions about how a feature works in an unfamiliar repo
extract a complete function or class at a given line or symbol name
list symbols and their line numbers in source files
code review and onboarding with a codebase-aware agent
stack: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Bedrock LLM providers
notable: Tree-sitter AST parsing returns complete semantic blocks instead of chunks that split mid-function
No indexing or embedding service required; search runs locally and deterministically
Elasticsearch-style query syntax with file, extension, and language filters
Works as an MCP server with raw tools or a full built-in agent, and reuses Claude Code or Codex auth per the README
LLM Script: a sandboxed JavaScript DSL for multi-step search, extract, and LLM pipelines
caveats: Agent features need an LLM provider: either Claude Code or Codex auth, or your own API key such as GOOGLE_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Optional LSP and indexing features are documented separately and are not described in detail in the README
Language support is listed explicitly; other languages are not covered in the README table
